title: NILS grants and detail
description: Record 25: what a person may open, as grants, and how much of a record they see, as detail. The desk's tokens carry both as the grants and detail claims. A grant names a page and how far a person goes there: see, or work, which includes see; the assistant has use. Detail is ordered, lowest first. The ladder's four names and assist stand for the sets in vectors/grants.json wherever they are still met.

detail.description: plain: neither class; quasi: the quasi-identifying class (sex and age) and the viewer's pixels; sensitive: the sensitive class, raw identifiers and burned-in annotation

step.description: A ladder name, as a ceiling or a binding still names it; it stands for its set

grants.description: The token's grants claim: plain strings. A reader drops a string it does not know.

detail.description: The token's detail claim. Absent or unknown reads as plain.
